attchmntText: Asian Hotels (North) Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Asian Hotels North Limited announced the Board approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 12, 2026. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 9,155.23 lakhs. The company reported a net loss of 32.93 lakhs for the quarter. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was 16,918.66 lakhs. The company reported a net loss of 386.96 lakhs for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified review conclusion. The company recognized an exceptional item of 448.97 lakhs related to past service cost under new Labour Codes. The company deposited 2159.66 crores with the Delhi High Court to secure title deeds for the Hyatt Regency property. Current liabilities exceed current assets as of September 30, 2026. Financial results are prepared on a going concern basis.
